notes.title: v.1.3.11 New Languages including French; Spanish; German; Italian; Portuguese; Turkish; Danish; Norwegian; Swedish; Dutch; Polish; Finnish.
notes.content:
Super Lemonade Factory has been translated into many languages. 

Complete list of languages:
English; French; Spanish; German; Italian; Portuguese; Turkish; Danish; Norwegian; Swedish; Dutch; Polish; Finnish.

There's some level tweaks.

Also, if you finish Old School Mode, you'll be awarded as the Retro Warrior and join the exclusive Platinum Pixel club.

Jump on board, let's play some Super Lemonade Factory.

notes.title: Full Screen is here
notes.content:
v1.2.5 of Super Lemonade Factory is here!

GET READY FOR ACTION

First of all, full screen is the default. It won't stretch the pixels. You'll get crystal clear pixels.

THE FUN OF DISCOVERY

There are easter eggs packed into the game. A quick search of reddit should point you in the right direction after a very smart player deciphered the codes.

Download v1.2.5 now!

notes.title: Super Lemonade Factory v1.1.2 out now
notes.content:
An awesome Steam user found a pretty weird bug that we left in from our testing days. It meant you could fly. Any time. Any where. It kind of defeated the purpose of a platformer.

The bug has been crushed, as well as various other level tuning and timing tuning.

We've just got stickers too! If you're in Australia or New Zealand we can post you a sticker to say thanks for supporting our little game. If you're somewhere else in the world, we'll set up an e-store soon because the cost of international postage is crazy these days. Just hit me with an email and the address to send it: initials@initialsgames.com

Check out the stickers: http://i.imgur.com/GeIn0Ar.jpg

Also, a big thank you to BundleStars who welcomed us with open arms into the Titanium Bundle. It was awesome being part of it (who wouldn't want to be mentioned in the same breath as Guacamelee!)

Don't forget to like us on Facebook for the chance to win a sticker pack https://www.facebook.com/pages/Super-Lemonade-Factory/308694105837846?ref=hl and as always tweet me at @initials_games

notes.title: Trading Cards Now Available
notes.content:
Hello Lemonaders,

We've now got trading cards!

[i]Series 1[/i] starts with a base pack of five cards.
[list]
    [*]Andre
    [*]Liselot
    [*]Mr Amsterdaam
    [*]Working Man Hero
    [*]Model sheets
[/list]

Collect them all!

Also, have you ever wanted to make your own level for [b]Super Lemonade Factory[/b]? You can, using the same tools as the dev to make custom levels.

Getting started is pretty easy. You can watch [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IDLqinZKixE] this YouTube video and see me make a level	 [/url]

Or, here are the instructions:

Find the file [i]"C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\SuperLemonadeFactory\SLF_levelEditor.zip"[/i] and unzip it.

Install the Ogmo Editor 0.918 from the folder ogmoEditor/ogmoEditor.air.

OR 

Download the Ogmo Editor from http://ogmoeditor.com/download/OgmoEditor.air

You'll need to download the Ogmo Editor version 0.918. This project may not work with Ogmo Editor v2.x.
The Ogmo Editor is a free and open source level editor created by Matt Thorson. It will run on Windows, Linux and OSX.

The Ogmo Editor requires Adobe Air. If you don't have Adobe Air installed, download it from Adobe's website. 

Once installed, open it up and go to File > Open Project.
Open the file _SuperLemonadeFactory.oep

From here you can open existing levels or create your own.
